description:
I'm Keith Pemberton. I spent 32 years in the fire service in the West Midlands and retired as a
Watch Manager. I've been to thousands of house fires, and I can tell you most of them started
with something small: a lead behind the sofa, a phone under a pillow, a pan left on the hob.

On this channel I tell families what actually starts fires at home, and the simple fixes that
cost next to nothing. No scare stories for the sake of it. Just what I've seen, and what I'd do.

New video every week. Independent channel, not official fire safety advice. In an emergency, dial 999.
